propositions: Helper functions absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table silently escape the registry scan, causing their environment variable reads to be undocumented
REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE are missing from docs/env-vars.md because _gate_str_pref is not registered despite being an environment-read helper

The scanner must fail closed on unregistered parameterized-shim helpers (functions whose os.environ key expression references their own parameters), mirroring the fail-closed behavior for unrecognized os.environ attributes

A dataflow-based predicate for detecting env-read helpers—functions whose key expression references one of their own parameters—is enumerable and sufficiently specific (9 of 557 files) to avoid false positives
Registering _gate_str_pref, read_secret_env, and _env_truthy in the helper table restores visibility of environment variables and raises the registry count from 162 to 164 keys
